module_summary: UART receiver with AXI-stream output: a bit-phase down-counter sequences start/data/stop bits on ticks from a prescale timer child, a SIPO child shifts sampled bits, and a valid stop bit latches the byte with overrun/frame error flags.

anchors.name: rxd
anchors.why: Serial receive line, registered into the sample flop.

anchors.name: phase_k
anchors.why: Bit-phase counter: loaded on start, decremented per bit tick; decodes start/data/stop phases.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received byte output, driven by the hold_w output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from ack_v, set on good stop bit, cleared by tready.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready clearing the output valid register.

anchors.name: smp
anchors.why: Registered rxd sample: shifted into SIPO and checked for start/stop bits.

anchors.name: tick_ok
anchors.why: Baud timer expiry from child; gates every phase step and start detection.

anchors.name: frag
anchors.why: Parallel output of the SIPO shift register child, latched on good stop.

anchors.name: kick
anchors.why: Start-bit detect: loads phase counter, half-bit timer and clears SIPO.

anchors.name: tail_good
anchors.why: Valid stop bit: loads output byte, sets valid and overrun check.

anchors.name: prescale
anchors.why: Baud divisor input loaded into the bit timer child.

anchors.name: t_go
anchors.why: Bit tick during an active frame; decrements phase counter.

anchors.name: in_body
anchors.why: Data-bit phase tick: advances SIPO and reloads full-bit timer.

anchors.name: in_head
anchors.why: Start-bit phase decode; aborts on false start.

anchors.name: in_tail
anchors.why: Stop-bit phase decode feeding frame check and tail_good.

anchors.name: overrun_error
anchors.why: Overrun pulse when new byte arrives while valid still set.

anchors.name: frame_error
anchors.why: Frame error pulse when stop bit sampled low.

groups.name: bit_sequencer
groups.description: Phase counter and decodes sequencing start, data and stop bits.

groups.name: baud_timer
groups.description: urx_tmr child counts full/half bit periods from prescale.

groups.name: deserializer
groups.description: Sampled rxd shifted into urx_sipo child to build the byte.

groups.name: axis_output
groups.description: Output byte and valid registers with AXI-stream ready handshake.

groups.name: status_flags
groups.description: Busy, overrun and frame error registers.
